what: Angle between the direction the physics engine gives for the Sun and the direction NASA Moon Trek's Sun angle service gives, for the same site and hour.

service.name: NASA Moon Trek, Sun azimuth and elevation service (getAzElfromT1)
service.request: one month per request, one request at a time, hourly samples
service.answers_kept: every answer unchanged, outside the repository; sha256 and size below

engine.positions: app.physics.engine.positions (MOON_ME, km, geometric, aberration correction NONE)

statistics: max_deg, p95_deg (value at rank 0.95 * (n - 1), rounded down) and mean_deg over every sample: the angle on the sky between the two directions, and the absolute difference in elevation.
